subject: planner: prevent unsafe outer join elimination when parent join predicates reference child columns (#66998)
summary: Reviewed this commit diff vs first parent. The planner change updates `OuterJoinEliminator.doOptimize` to propagate join predicate columns (`Equal/Left/Right/Other/NAEQ` conditions) in addition to output schema columns when computing `parentCols`, preventing unsafe elimination of child outer-joins whose columns are still referenced by a parent join’s predicates (`pkg/planner/core/rule_join_elimination.go`). A regression test for issue #66399 was added to ensure the query no longer errors/panics (`pkg/planner/core/issuetest/planner_issue_test.go`). No Blocker/High issues found in SQL semantics/correctness. Checked later history up to `upstream/master`; no subsequent changes to `pkg/planner/core/rule_join_elimination.go` that would indicate a follow-up fix was needed.
